what: Text queries typed into the live Hugging Face Space (cpu-basic: 2 vCPU, 16 GB) from a browser on a home connection, 2026-10-03 ~21:02-21:10 EDT, right after the Space was rebuilt.
cold_start: First page load after the rebuild showed the search UI about 20 s after the request (includes downloading the model weights and the index from the Hub).

fields.server_reported: The app's own timer: text encoding + ranking all 8,091 photos, measured on the Space.
fields.results_visible_ms: Browser time from pressing Enter until the new top caption is on screen (includes the websocket round trip).
fields.all_12_thumbnails_loaded_ms: Browser time from pressing Enter until all 12 thumbnails have finished loading from the Hugging Face CDN.

note: 'a dog catching a frisbee' reports 6 ms both times because its text embedding was already cached (st.cache_data); only ranking ran. The kayak query below was timed by the server only.
